inShort: A and B dink cross-court, and either may suddenly change direction: down the line, middle or deep. The other has to keep it low.
rules: A and B dink cross-court at the kitchen line.
Either of you picks your own moment to change direction: down the line, to the middle at the inside foot, or a deeper dink that pushes the other back.
No arranged switch: the change has to come out of the rally.
The other player reacts and tries to keep the next ball low.
A pop-up or a miss is a point for the other player.
Play to 11, then play the other diagonal.
tooEasy: For 5 minutes, no cross-court at all: middle only, which forces new patterns.
tooHard: At most three direction changes per rally, so the pattern stays readable.
goodLooksLike: The other player can't tell when the change is coming, and still keeps the reply low over the net.
